optionsIntroduction.message: Choose a calm Chrome Voice or connect ElevenLabs directly with your own Provider Credential. Speak-O has no account or subscription.

optionsSpeechDescription.message: Select how Speak-O turns an Article into a controlled spoken experience.

optionsRememberDescription.message: Chrome profile storage protects a remembered key; Speak-O does not add application-level encryption.

optionsPreviewUnavailable.message: Preview unavailable; Speak-O will not generate a paid preview.

optionsReadingDescription.message: Keep Reading Position and visual orientation under your control.

optionsHighlightDescription.message: Use exact CSS Highlight ranges on the original Source Page.

optionsFollowDescription.message: Scroll only when the current sentence leaves a comfortable viewport area.

optionsUsageGuardDescription.message: Pause before submitting more source characters in one Cloud Voice Reading Session.

optionsAppearanceDescription.message: Use a neutral interface that stays independent from the Source Page.

optionsShortcutsDescription.message: Chrome owns global assignments and reports conflicts or missing keys.

optionsPrivacyDescription.message: Speak-O keeps Rekh outside the Article and Provider Credential data path.

optionsPrivacySummary.message: Rekh receives no Article text, Provider Credentials, Provider Usage, diagnostics, or behavioral data.

optionsPrivacyDetail.message: Chrome Voice Mode creates no Speech Provider request from Speak-O. Cloud Voice Mode sends only the submitted source text directly to ElevenLabs using your credential. Preferences stay in local extension storage; active audio uses session storage and is cleared by Chrome when the extension session ends.

optionsFooterDetail.message: Apache-2.0 · Published by Rekh · No Speak-O account required
